Practice chanters in 3D

How to use this view

Drag to turn, scroll or pinch to zoom; draw Explode to spread the plates along the chanter. Every plate is the cut files’ own outline. The finger-hole plates are darker: a slot through the face, or a V where a hole too small to cut is drilled. The cap, paler, is on, its socket over the body’s top plates. The buttons switch between the bores, three sides to eight, and the two strip chanters, square bores of four finger-jointed strips, darker, under stacked plates: strips with holes to the model’s hand layout, and standard with a measured chanter’s.
